recipe_search_outcome.interpretation: No qualifying new recipe was confirmed in the four-query scope. Dynamic page extraction and indexing limit this conclusion; the leaderboard can contain stronger private methods.

own_project_context_parent_report.public_score_precision_note: A displayed three-decimal score is not proof of exact equality or a guaranteed margin to 0.955.
